claim_one_line: THE CLOCK-COHERENCE RUN (route B4, the D2 gate; executed the moment 5A returned): SPLIT VERDICT -- the named primary test PASSES and the full census check FAILS, so neither declared outcome fires cleanly and D2 sharpens into a scope question that is the OWNER'S. THE CONDITION (cloud weld-book addendum 2): paying LEAP-1 (CS-time conjugate to Lambda) and W1 (4-volume-time conjugate to Lambda) together requires the two to be THE SAME CLOCK up to monotone reparameterization -- along the (1,n) ladder CS must be monotone in Vol, with the full check across B289's banked 78-closing census. TWO CATCHES BEFORE ANY VERDICT, both mine, both narrated: (i) WRONG CENSUS -- the first sweep used the 112-member shape-field family instead of the Dehn-filling closings, caught by re-reading the source condition; that output discarded as off-target. (ii) VACUITY TRAP -- the corrected run first returned an EMPTY census (SnapPy's CS fudge must be primed on the UNFILLED manifold before filling, exactly as B289's instrument does) and all() over an empty sequence printed MONOTONE=True over nothing; caught by the printed census size, with a vacuity guard (assert >= 10 rungs) now committed -- the MB12 class self-caught pre-bank. THE INSTRUMENT, CONTROLLED TWO-SIDEDLY: the corrected sweep finds EXACTLY 78 distinct hyperbolic closings (B289's banked census size, reproduced independently); B289's banked sign law CS(p,-q) = -CS(p,q) holds 156/156 on the mirror pairs; a shuffle control yields 36 violations, so the monotonicity detector demonstrably BITES. THE RESULT: the (1,n) LADDER IS MONOTONE over 29 rungs (n=2..30) -- Vol strictly increasing 1.398508884 -> 2.026719753 toward Vol_cusp = 2.029883212819 while |CS| strictly decreases 0.246607253 -> 0.016665127 toward 0; the p=1 census family likewise monotone. BUT GLOBALLY across the 78 closings sorted by volume, |CS| is NOT non-increasing (15 violations), and EVERY family p >= 2 carries an exhibited within-family violation (p=2: (2,-3) V=1.737124 |CS|=0.169123 -> (2,5) V=1.919520 |CS|=0.200608; p=5: (5,-1) V=0.981369 |CS|=0.077038 -> (5,-2) V=1.529477 |CS|=0.234622; five more listed in FINDINGS). Interpretive, labeled: the families sit at DIFFERENT |CS| SCALES, so the global failure is family-stratification, not noise. THE ROUTED CONSEQUENCE: if the physical clock is a single realized trajectory -- and the (1,n) cusp-approaching ladder is the record's own distinguished path (B289/B303) -- the joint LEAP-1+W1 package SURVIVES its test and is payable at the stated price; if coherence must hold across the whole closing census simultaneously (the stronger reading: a statement about the two VARIABLES rather than one path), the joint package is REFUTED and the choice becomes AMS-clock XOR HT-clock. Both readings are defensible; the run cannot choose between them, and saying so is the honest verdict. The measurement is banked so the decision is made on data rather than in advance. Gate 5 clean.
